stem: A store raises the price of a ₱500 item by 20%. Later, it gives 20% off the new price. What is the final price?
hints: Do one change at a time. The 20% off is taken from the new price, not from ₱500.
First the increase: 20% of ₱500 is ₱100, so the new price is ₱600.
Now find 20% of ₱600 and subtract it from ₱600.

solution.methodName: Two percent changes: do them one at a time

steps.why: The discount is 20% of the new price, ₱600. That is more than the ₱100 that was added.

trapNotes.₱500: This assumes +20% and −20% cancel out. The discount is 20% of ₱600, which is ₱120, more than the ₱100 that was added.
trapNotes.₱600: This is the price after the increase only. The 20% discount still has to be taken off.
trapNotes.₱400: This takes 20% off the original ₱500 and ignores the increase.
